info.name: VegaMart — Maintenance Control
info.description:
Control VegaMart maintenance mode.

Endpoints:
  * GET  /api/v1/system/maintenance/status — public flag + message (no auth)
  * POST /api/v1/system/maintenance/on     — enable maintenance (loopback only, message 'Contact the developer')
  * POST /api/v1/system/maintenance/off    — disable maintenance (loopback only)

The /on and /off toggles are restricted to requests originating from the server itself (localhost). The /system namespace and /health endpoints are excluded from the maintenance gate.

request.description: Publicly readable maintenance flag and message. No auth required. Served even while maintenance mode is active.

Turns on maintenance mode with the message 'Contact the developer'. Only reachable from the server (loopback) — run over SSH with curl. All requests except /health, /metrics, /docs and /system/* will receive HTTP 503 with { maintenance: true, message }.
Turns off maintenance mode and restores normal API access. Only reachable from the server (loopback) — run over SSH with curl.
